name: Motor short-circuit fuse
summary: An aM fuse-link is a partial-range fuse used for motor-circuit short-circuit protection.
description: An aM fuse-link is a partial-range fuse used for motor-circuit short-circuit protection. The drawing must identify the separate overload protective function associated with the motor feeder.
readingNotes: Trace the overload relay as a separate element in the control and trip circuits.
The preview is an original explanation of this function. Match the actual drawing convention to its legend and the selected equipment documentation.
distinction: An aM fuse does not provide the same full-range overload protection as a general-purpose gG fuse.
